## About this guide

Load lookup settings, resolve a form model and prepare shared reference snapshots.

## Load a form model

```{r}
# Load the selected ROS form model.
form_model_definition <- ros.form.model::ros_form(
  name = ros.form.model::ROS_FORM_LL,
  version = ros.form.model::ROS_FORM_VERSION_4_2_0)
```

## Load reference configuration

```{r}
# Read the bundled catalogue sources and lookup settings without downloading data.
reference_configuration <- ros.form.references::ros_lookup_configuration()
# Resolve the model bindings while keeping the original form model unchanged.
reference_resolved_form_model <- ros.form.references::resolve_ros_lookups(
  form_model_definition, reference_configuration)
# Inspect the configured catalogues.
names(reference_configuration$catalogues)
```

## Prepare snapshots

Copy the configuration and adjust the sources for your deployment.

For private catalogues, use the complete private example and set `ROS_REGISTRY_PASSWORD` in your environment.

These commands require access to the configured catalogues.

```{r eval=FALSE}
# Read the deployment configuration, including credentials from the environment.
reference_configuration <- ros.form.references::ros_lookup_configuration("references.private.example.yaml")
# Download and verify the tables selected by the form model.
reference_snapshot_directory <- ros.form.references::prepare_ros_reference_snapshots(
  "references",
  reference_configuration$catalogues$code_lists$source,
  reference_configuration$catalogues$registries$source,
  models = list(form_model_definition),
  configuration = reference_configuration)
# Load the saved rows, aliases and lookup settings for consumers.
reference_snapshots <- ros.form.references::read_ros_references(
  reference_snapshot_directory, list(form_model_definition))
```

Snapshots contain catalogue CSV directories and `references.yaml` with frozen lookup settings.

Credentials are never written into the snapshot configuration.
